style: Full-color comic book illustration, graphic novel style: bold clean ink linework, flat cel colors with soft halftone shading, cinematic composition, wide 16:9 landscape image. Absolutely NO text, NO letters, NO words, NO numbers, NO logos, NO speech bubbles, NO captions anywhere in the image. Characters drawn from behind or in silhouette unless stated. TEAM LOOK RULE: whenever team members appear, they are stealthy professional cat burglars, like a classy heist-movie crew of thieves: black turtlenecks, slim dark coats or fitted jackets, black leather gloves, knit beanies or hoods, small backpacks and tool rolls, lean and agile, moving quietly. They must NOT look like soldiers, police or SWAT: absolutely no helmets, no tactical vests, no body armor, no military uniforms, no knee pads, no rifles.
items: cover

A rainy night on a small European-style shopping street built inside a dark underground space with exposed black ducts and pipes on the ceiling. Glowing shop fronts in purple, red, gold and navy reflect on wet cobblestones. In the center, a single sacred crimson fruit with a small green leaf floats in the air above the street, radiating intense golden holy light: radiant light rays like a halo, a soft glowing aura, luminous golden particles and tiny light petals swirling around it, raindrops near it glowing and suspended in midair. It looks like a divine relic, awe-inspiring and mysterious. Silhouettes of people on the street turning to look at it. Deep navy and teal palette with neon accents and warm gold light at the center.

Warm lamplit hideout room at night: an old grandfather with white beard, round glasses and a knitted vest sits in a wooden rocking chair, telling a story with a gentle smile. A small child sits on the floor in front of him, seen only from behind (back of head). Old CRT monitors, tools and cables on shelves, rain on the window. Warm amber and brown palette, cozy and nostalgic.

Dark cramped hacker room lit only by green computer monitors: several monitors showing glowing green window panels and world map interfaces (no readable text). Three or four young people in dark hoodies seen from behind, leaning toward the screens. Cables, a laptop, a desktop tower with rainbow LED. Green and black palette, tense late-night atmosphere.

Close-up of a hacker room: a large monitor suddenly shows a single dark message window with a glowing red snake emblem in the corner (no readable text). Silhouettes of a team turning around in surprise, green light on their shoulders. Dramatic lighting, green and black with a red accent.

Secret VIP room behind a stylish bar with purple neon ceiling light and a white marble counter with bar stools. A city map is spread on a table. Across the table sits a figure completely hidden in shadow, faceless; the shadow on the wall behind him stretches upward in the shape of a giant snake. The team seen from behind. Purple, black and magenta palette, noir mood.

High-angle bird's-eye comic illustration, drawn like an old hand-drawn map on paper, of ONE narrow underground cobblestone street seen lengthwise: small shop fronts line BOTH sides of the street, facing each other across the narrow lane (about four shops on the left side and four on the right side), each with a different colored facade or awning (purple, red, white tile, cream, black with gold, navy, red kiosk, dark green). Wooden benches and old black street lamps stand along the lane, rain falls, puddles reflect lamplight, exposed pipes on the dark ceiling above. On one side, the cream-colored shop sits right next to the dark green awning shop, and its middle door is circled with a loose red pen circle. Do not write ANY words or labels anywhere.

Four-panel comic layout (2x2 grid, panels separated by white gutters) showing four shop fronts at night in the rain: 1) a black bar door with a glowing purple neon interior, 2) a white boutique with a pastel pink double door and red neon glow, 3) a white glossy tiled salon with high heel shoes displayed on plates in the window, 4) a cream-colored storefront with warm golden lighting and brown shutter doors. Each panel has a tiny blue hexagon security badge on the wall. All shop signboards, awnings and windows must be completely BLANK and plain with no lettering at all; leave the top area of each panel slightly darker and empty.

Four-panel comic layout (2x2 grid, panels separated by white gutters) showing four shop fronts at night: 1) a black cafe front with gold lattice window and a chalkboard easel, 2) a navy and white boutique with a lion head emblem shape and a white dress on a mannequin in the window, 3) a red newspaper kiosk with a red awning, shutters closed, 4) a darker, ominous pawn shop with a dark green awning and green blinds, drawn darker than the others. All shop signboards, awnings and windows must be completely BLANK and plain with no lettering at all; leave the top area of each panel slightly darker and empty.

Dramatic wide comic panel at night in torrential rain on an underground shopping street: a lightning flash, a crew of four thieves in dark coats, turtlenecks and beanies seen from behind with small flashlight beams. In front of them, a cream-colored small grocery store front with wooden crates of fruit (oranges, grapes) in its lit display windows on both sides; its two tall plain dark-brown door panels have just swung wide open outward like cabinet doors (completely plain, NO letters), revealing a brushed silver riveted steel vault door that fills the doorway: heavy metal plates, rivets and welded brackets, a large round spoked wheel handle in the middle, and a small glowing square screen set into the upper part of the door. Cold blue light spills from it. The steel looks impossibly solid. Absolutely no text or letters anywhere. Deep blue palette, white lightning, high tension.

Comic triptych (three vertical panels with white gutters), purely visual with zero lettering: left, close-up of a brushed silver riveted steel vault door with a large round spoked wheel handle and a small square screen near the top glowing red, set inside a grocery store doorway between two open dark-brown door panels; middle, an explosion bursting from a sewer grate in the street, the blast knocking down a brick wall, bricks flying; right, inside a white-walled shop, a jagged ragged hole in a grey brick wall with fallen bricks on a white marble floor, revealing behind it a grey steel ventilation hatch with horizontal louver slats, a narrow gap at its edge; a thief in a black turtleneck and beanie, seen from behind, turns a red valve wheel on a pipe and a stream of water gushes into that narrow gap. No sound effects, no captions, no words. Blue-grey palette with orange explosion.
s09b

Wide comic panel inside a small pawn shop with white walls: wall shelves holding bronze statuettes, antique vases and necklace display busts, a key cabinet. In the middle of the room, a long dark green counter topped with exactly THREE separate glass display boxes side by side, and each glass box holds only ONE single handgun lying on a white base (three guns in total, no more). One glass box is open and empty because a team member, seen from behind, has just taken its gun out. In the corner, a jagged ragged hole in a grey brick wall with fallen bricks on the white marble floor reveals a grey steel ventilation hatch with horizontal louver slats; another team member aims a pistol at it, a bright muzzle flash, and the louvered hatch is bending and flying off its frame. Dim tense lighting, dark green and grey palette with an orange muzzle flash. No text, no letters, no words anywhere.

The brightest, most awe-inspiring scene: emerging from a dark jagged crack into a hidden chamber, a huge lush tree with bright green leaves bursts out of a broken old white metal safe, its roots spreading over red-orange earth and patches of green grass, soft light falling through the leaves and mist. Small silhouettes of a team seen from behind look up at the tree in wonder. Vivid greens, warm red earth.

Comic diptych (two panels with a white gutter): LEFT, a breathtaking close-up among lush tree branches: a white blossom on a branch is transforming into a single sacred crimson fruit growing directly from the branch by its own stem (NOT inside any box, cage or case), the fruit radiating warm golden holy light with radiant light rays, a glowing aura and floating golden particles, the surrounding leaves lit up gold, a gloved hand reaching toward it slowly in awe; RIGHT, a crew of thieves in dark coats and beanies scrambling out through a jagged hole in a grey brick wall into a dark rainy street at night, one person hugging a black hard-shell briefcase with golden light leaking from its seams, and behind them a blinding white explosion flash bursting from the hole. Divine gold and green on the left, dark blue and white on the right. No text.

Comic diptych (two panels with a white gutter), no text or readable writing anywhere: LEFT, night and heavy rain at the base of a yellow brick wall, a black iron floor drain hatch with a barred grate lid flipped open, and gloved hands lowering a black hard-shell briefcase with faint golden light leaking from its seams down into the dark flowing water of the drain; RIGHT, on a dim wooden table, blank-covered passports, plain blank ID cards and banded stacks of cash being picked up by several different hands, and through a rainy window behind, silhouettes of people walking away in different directions and an airplane's lights crossing the night sky. Dark blue and amber palette, bittersweet farewell mood.
s12b

Wide comic panel: an empty stylish bar after a long absence, purple neon glow along the ceiling, a white marble bar counter with black bar stools, faint dust floating in a cold beam of light, nobody behind the bar. On the marble counter lies a single sealed cream-colored envelope with a dark red wax seal shaped like a coiled snake, lit like a spotlight. In the doorway, one person stands still in silhouette, seen from behind, looking at the letter. Mysterious and melancholic. Purple, black and pale violet palette. No text, no letters, no words anywhere, the envelope has no writing.
s12c

Close-up still life comic illustration on a white marble bar counter under soft purple neon light. Keep the LEFT HALF of the image as plain, softly lit empty marble (nothing there). On the RIGHT HALF: an opened cream-colored envelope with a broken dark red wax seal shaped like a coiled snake; beside it a single small glossy crimson pill capsule glowing with a faint golden aura and tiny light particles, resting on a little dark velvet cloth; and a matte black premium card with a gold chip, an ornate silver filigree border, and in its center a hand-drawn iridescent holographic illustration of a curling vine with a small fruit and leaves (an original ornamental design, NOT a corporate logo, NOT a simple apple silhouette). Mysterious and luxurious mood. Purple, black, gold and crimson palette. No text, no letters, no words anywhere, the card and envelope have no writing.

Warm lamplit hideout room at night, the lamp slightly dimmer: an old grandfather with white beard and round glasses sits in a rocking chair, holding an old yellowed envelope with a broken dark red wax seal on his lap, a folded letter peeking out (no readable writing). For the first time we see the child's face: a young boy with sparkling curious eyes looking up at his grandfather. Rain on the window. Warm amber palette, tender and mysterious ending. No text.

Top-down view of a wooden desk with two scattered classified documents (blank paper, no readable text) with a red stamp mark shape and black redaction bars, a paper clip, a coffee ring, and a small sticky note. Comic illustration with paper texture, muted beige and grey palette with a red accent.
